# BestKitchenCompare

BestKitchenCompare is a content-commerce website focused on home and kitchen appliances.

Purpose:
- Help users discover, compare, and research appliances.
- Publish buying guides, reviews, and comparison content.
- Recommend products using affiliate links.

Main sections:
- Homepage: /
- Categories: /category/{slug}
- Products: /product/{slug}
- Brands: /brand/{slug}
- Compare: /compare
- Blog: /blog
- About: /about
- Disclaimer: /disclaimer
- Privacy Policy: /privacy-policy
- Contact: /contact

Policies:
- Product prices are intentionally not displayed.
- Recommendation buttons use “Check Latest Price on Amazon”.
- Affiliate disclosure appears near recommendation areas.
